description: Reviewed GitHub issue graph for the Coven Automations v1 program. GitHub owns outcomes, execution ownership, dependencies, acceptance gates, and delivery evidence. Runtime state stays in Coven.

sync.source: GitHub REST issue state; reviewed snapshot, not a live readiness report.
sync.drift_check: node docs/roadmaps/drift-check.mjs --strict; optionally --issues-export PATH with a local GitHub REST JSON issue array.

github.title: Program: Coven Automations v1 — reliable, identity-bound familiar routines

outcomes.acceptance_gate: Owns release gates and cross-repository rollup; final #854 release rollup must be generable from reconciled tracker state and exact evidence. Must not be used as a catch-all implementation task.

github.title: P0 control: Operationalize Coven Automations v1 through the reviewed issue graph and delivery evidence

outcomes.acceptance_gate: Program issues, ownership, dependencies, and delivery evidence are published and reviewable.

github.title: Native familiar automations: replace harness-owned schedules with durable Coven routines

outcomes.acceptance_gate: #816 evidence checklist: landed commit/PR series linked with an exact final foundation revision; clean-clone automation-test verification; pre-automations schema migration and rollback proof; daemon startup/tick/shutdown/restart proof on supported platforms; one scheduled and one manual run shown to traverse the same claim/ledger/runtime/delivery path; stale lease cannot block the next eligible occurrence indefinitely; failed output delivery cannot report success; every original acceptance criterion reconciled as implemented, deferred, or superseded; Cave ownership migration (OpenCoven/coven-cave#4990) linked with remaining compatibility facade documented.
evidence: https://github.com/OpenCoven/coven/pull/896 (merged 2026-09-01; settle automation runs from terminal evidence)
foundation merge commit for #896 recorded in Cave PR OpenCoven/coven-cave#5277 (exact SHA kept out of this file per the repository secret guard)
https://github.com/OpenCoven/coven/pull/846 (merged 2026-08-28; routine definitions and control actions, part 1)

github.title: P0: Specify coven.automations.v1 schemas, state machines, idempotency, and changefeed

outcomes.acceptance_gate: coven.automations.v1 schemas, state machines, idempotency rules, and changefeed contract are specified, reviewed, and covered by tests; schema/conformance artifact revisions recorded as evidence.

github.title: P0: Harden automation time, retries, cancellation, fencing, and crash recovery

outcomes.acceptance_gate: Time, retry, cancellation, fencing, and crash-recovery behaviors verified by tests, including stale-lease recovery, misfire semantics, and cancellation without duplicate execution.

github.title: P0: Bind automation runs to principal authority, familiar revisions, capabilities, approvals, and receipts

outcomes.acceptance_gate: Runs are bound to principal authority, familiar revisions, capabilities, approvals, and receipts; negative tests prove authority bypass fails closed; receipts are tamper-evident and out of tracker scope.

github.title: P0: Build automations conformance, chaos, SLO, and operator diagnostics

outcomes.acceptance_gate: Conformance, chaos, SLO, and operator-diagnostics suites exist and run without ambient production credentials; the v1 release gate report is produced from them and linked here.

github.title: P0 profile: Define universal familiar embodiment binding for automation and direct runs

cross_repository_children.acceptance_gate: A universal familiar embodiment binding is specified and reviewed so an automation run and a direct run resolve the same familiar revision, capabilities, and identity; conformance covers both entry paths.

github.title: P0 profile: Define automation authority, approvals, and degrade-to-proposal semantics

cross_repository_children.acceptance_gate: Automation authority, approval requirements, and degrade-to-proposal semantics are specified with negative tests proving an under-authorized run degrades to a proposal instead of executing.

github.title: P1: Add constrained Coven Automations SDK types, subscriptions, verification, and authority-aware commands

cross_repository_children.acceptance_gate: SDK automation types, subscriptions, verification helpers, and authority-aware commands are published against the certified core, with the exact package version and conformance run recorded as evidence.

github.title: P1: Complete Coven Automations oversight, approvals, recovery, and compatibility retirement

cross_repository_children.acceptance_gate: Cave operator oversight, approval handling, and recovery surfaces run against the certified core, and the pre-automations compatibility facade is retired or its remaining scope is documented.

github.title: P1: Define the Psyche adapter for automation-triggered orchestration without owning schedules

cross_repository_children.acceptance_gate: Psyche consumes automation triggers through the certified public contract and demonstrably does not own schedules, occurrences, leases, or run state.

github.title: P1: Publish Coven Automations v1 protocol, operator, migration, and troubleshooting documentation

cross_repository_children.acceptance_gate: Protocol, operator, migration, and troubleshooting documentation is published against the certified contract revision and links the exact schema/conformance artifacts.

github.title: P1: Add reusable Coven Automations conformance, contract-drift, and roadmap checks

cross_repository_children.acceptance_gate: Reusable organization-level conformance, contract-drift, and roadmap checks run on consumer repositories without ambient production credentials and fail closed on drift.

cross_repository_children_policy: Each child is tracked in its owning repository. Preserve the seven declared cross-repository outcomes and their explicit dependencies; a closed profile prerequisite does not certify the production consumer.
p2_exclusions_policy: These remain post-v1 (P2) and must not be encoded as implicit P0 blockers anywhere in the graph.
invariants: Every program outcome has one canonical GitHub issue and a unique slug.
Required program and cross-repository membership is pinned in the checker.
Dependencies name declared outcomes, remain acyclic, and never query production runtime state.
P0 outcomes name an accountable owner, acceptance gate, and explicit disposition.
Closed outcomes retain public delivery evidence; issue state alone is not production certification.
Generated roadmap rows change through node docs/roadmaps/drift-check.mjs --render.
Tracker artifacts contain no credentials, private prompts, raw terminal output, or personal paths.
tracker: GitHub issues in the owning repository
